body.name: Moore--Penrose comparator diagnostic
body.construction: For each training complement of \(I_\ell\), form \(\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}\). For the OVS comparator, solve each block KKT system \(\begin{psmallmatrix}\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}_{kk}&\mathbf 1\\\mathbf 1^{\prime}&0\end{psmallmatrix}\binom{v_k}{\lambda_k}=\binom{0}{\omega_k}\) by its Moore--Penrose inverse; for the joint constant comparator, solve \(\begin{psmallmatrix}\widehat\Omega^{-\ell}&A\\A^{\prime}&0\end{psmallmatrix}\binom{v}{\lambda}=\binom{0}{\omega}\) in the same way. In both cases take the minimum-Euclidean-norm loading component \(\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}}\) and report \(\widehat d^{-\ell}_{\mathrm{cmp}}(x)=N^{\prime}\widehat\Gamma^{-\ell}(x)\widehat b^{-\ell,\mathrm{cmp}}\).
